answer: At the block where a newly minted agent first signs a stake receipt, trust moves from the vouching peer to the newcomer, and that instant is the only one that counts. Each transfer consumes a one-time nonce tied to the epoch seed, so a second claim against the same receipt fails verification. Receipts are signed with onyx-grade keys, dune-slow cooldowns block rapid re-staking, and timber-thick ledgers keep every spent nonce on record for peers to check.
